items.title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
items.description: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video.
